reviews.title: What a downgrade
reviews.text: Why all of a sudden do you have pay to see upcoming releases???? So dumb

reviews.title: What happened to looking at shoes for free?
reviews.text: Haven’t been on the app for a while. Recently went to login and seen that I have to pay a subscription to see unreleased sneakers? Been using this app for years why all of sudden I got to pay?

reviews.title: Is this app broken?
reviews.text: There are no raffles available on the app, but there are a ton on other shoe apps now. The last news article is from JAN 2026. I paid for a subscription, but I’m not sure why. Is this what everyone else is seeing? I tried to contact their team but haven’t heard back. Hopefully, I can get this figured out on here.
